topic: Website launch checklist: 5 things to check before going live
caption:
Launching a new website? Check these 5 things before you hit publish. 🚀

1️⃣ Speed on a real phone
2️⃣ Every form actually sends
3️⃣ Basic SEO is in place
4️⃣ Analytics are tracking
5️⃣ Security and backups

Small misses here quietly cost you visitors and leads from day one. Swipe for what to check in each. →

Launching soon? DM us LAUNCH and we'll go through this checklist with you.

Save this for your next launch. 🔖

#WebDevelopment #WebsiteLaunch #SEO #WebPerformance #SmallBusiness #StartupTips #Founders #NextJS

slides.title: Check these 5 things before you go live.
slides.sub: Small misses here cost you visitors on day one.

slides.title: Speed on a real phone
slides.body: Test on mobile data, not office Wi-Fi. Compress images and cut heavy scripts.

slides.title: Every form actually sends
slides.body: Submit each contact and booking form yourself. Check the email arrives in the right inbox.

slides.title: Basic SEO is in place
slides.body: Unique page titles, meta descriptions, a sitemap, and no “noindex” left over from staging.

slides.title: Analytics are tracking
slides.body: Install analytics and test it. Without day-one data, you can't tell what's working.

slides.title: Security and backups
slides.body: HTTPS everywhere, updated plugins and libraries, and a tested backup you can restore.
